question: Which of the following does NOT belong to the cytoskeleton filaments?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Centrioles**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Centrioles are involved in cell division** and organizing microtubules but are not classified as cytoskeletal filaments.
 
• Centrioles are** small organelles involved in cell division**
 
• A cytoskeleton is found in the cytoplasm as a network of protein filaments.
 
• Centrioles are composed of **nine triplets of microtubules arranged in a circular pattern**.
 
• During cell division, **they duplicate to form two centrioles, **which move to opposite poles of the cell, assisting in the formation of the spindle fibers that help in chromosome segregation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• There are three types of cytoskeletons found in the cytoplasm- microtubules, microfilaments, and intermediate filaments.
 
• They are found only in eukaryotic cells.
 
• Cytoskeleton provides mechanical support to the cell and helps maintain the shape of the cell.
 
• They are important for cell division and movements inside the cell.
 
• They also function in supporting the cell organelle and allow cell motility.
